prompt.content: 33. How many six-digit numbers are there in which all digits are odd?

What is the positive difference between $\frac{8^2 - 8^2}{8}$ and $\frac{8^2 \times 8^2}{8}$?

$90\% - 100\%$& IIII\\
$80\% - 89\%$& IIII IIII\\

$60\% - 69\%$ & IIII I\\
Below $60\%$ & II
\end{tabular}
